assistant_text.text: Hello! In about five minutes I will show you two agents talking, then a small mission running. You can say skip any time.
I started a second agent beside this chat. I asked it a question, and you can see its answer. Two agents sent each other messages, and either can wake the other.
You watched a small mission run: a goal, owners and a recorded result. What do you want to accomplish in Smalltalk today?
You have been quiet, so I will leave it here for now. I am available whenever you want to start, and phone pairing and GitHub are there when you want them.
